5. The minimization of noise and visual impacts of the proposed Downtown Expressway on the residential areas of the project area.
Again, in weighing the balance of impacts, it appears that the inconveniences and the initations that will be experienced during construction are very much overshadowed by the substantial improvement of the Randolph environment. Virtually every adverse impact will be corrected by the completion of the project action. Moreover, a new atmosphere will emerge that will be conducive to continued maintenance of the improved character.
B. Irretrievable and Irreversible Commitments of Resources
1. No loss of open space, or foreclosure of programmed development or preservation options will result due to implementation of the proposed project.
   A large commitment of such resources as land, money, community infrastructure and services will have to be made to complete the project. 
a. Project Expenditures will total an estimated $26,290,704.00. A complete breakdown of these expenditures can be found in the Appendix, Exhibit No. 8.
b. Community infrastructure improvements, and site improvements will total an estimated $7,837,753.00. Demolition costs to include sidewalks, pavement, curb and gutters, appurtenances, and structures will total an estimated $1,217,065.00.
